text:
jordan: Quick follow-up from the postmortem -- I exported the action list and added due-date suggestions. Please confirm owners + firm ETA by EOD Weds. Sheet: https://redwood.company/sheets/pm-actions. TL;DR: 4 items (network patch, cache tuning, rollout canary, customer comms). Ping if blocked.

priya: Ack. I can own the network patch. ETA Fri 2026-03-26. I need staging GPU access to validate the fix (staging cluster).

sam: I'll take cache eviction tuning. Tentative ETA Tue 2026-03-30. Plan: perf bench + validation against canary traffic.

leila: I can own customer comms draft. ETA Mon 2026-03-29. Do we have a legal-approved template or should I draft and loop in legal after?

jordan: Thanks. For rollout canary I wanted to ask @mike_s to own the execution and monitoring. If you can't, I'll step in.

mike_s: Happy to. I'll run the canary, monitor error-rate and latency; will escalate if error rate > 2% or SLOs breach. ETA Wed 2026-03-31. I'll add a dashboard and a watch in Console.

ops-bot: reminder: Added the due dates to the tracker and set a follow-up reminder for 3 days before each due date.

priya: Re: staging GPUs -- @infra, can you grant the 'staging-gpu' role to priya by EOD? I need it to reproduce the issue end-to-end.

infra_bot: Grant request created (ticket #4321). Estimated turnaround: 2 business days. I assigned to infra-team.

jordan: If anyone thinks the ETAs are optimistic, shout now and add a short blocker note. Also tagging @security for a quick review of the comms once Leila posts it.

security: I'll review the draft within 24 hours after Leila posts. If we need a legal hold or redacted customer info we'll call it out. No major issues expected.

sam: Quick bench note: with current settings we see ~5% perf regression under canary traffic if we don't change KV cache policy. I'll include the config diff in this thread.

sam: ```diff
- cache.eviction=LRU
+ cache.eviction=LFU
+ cache.max_entries=20000
```

leila: Uploaded initial comms draft to the sheet: https://redwood.company/sheets/pm-actions#comms. @security please review when you get a sec.

priya: Acknowledged. I'll update ticket #4321 when staging access is granted. :thumbsup:

jordan: Great. I'll do a sync in two days to close any gaps. Thanks all :rocket:
